items.context: Crypto Varo (@crypto_varo, 37.423 seguidores, en inglés): el mínimo de la semana, $55.106, quedó 19% bajo la media de 200 semanas; marzo 2020 llegó 30% bajo y el fondo de 2022, 36%. "Por esos estándares, esta limpieza es de tamaño medio". ~13 min, 21 likes, 9 reposts y solo 3 respuestas: cuenta mediana con un post que está despegando sobre la media de 200 semanas.
items.suggested_text:
Depth is only half of that comparison; the other half is time. A 30% wick that reclaims the average within weeks and a 36% grind that lives below it for months are very different markets, even if the lows look similar on a chart.

That's also why this signal is risky to read alone. Distance to the 200-week average is one of the four inputs in our Market Temperature index, next to MVRV, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted momentum, and the read changes a lot depending on whether the other three confirm it.

"Mid-sized" by depth is fair. Whether it stays mid-sized is mostly a question of how many weekly closes $BTC spends down there.
